files.description: Short bright synthetic meow on projectile launch
Higher rough startled synthetic cat yelp on damage
Soft rising cartoon spring for both jumps
Crisp paw impact on every projectile hit, including lethal hits
Two coarse bird calls with a wing rush at attack start
Three quick squirrel chirps and a light launch rustle
Accelerating raspy wing buzz on the bee dash
Airy snake hiss with a low dirt pop on emergence
